name: secbin
description: secbin — zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted notes and file sharing with accounts, view limits and expiry. Content is encrypted/decrypted client-side (AES-256-GCM, Argon2id); the server only ever stores ciphertext.

scripts.test: vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.node.config.js && vitest run --config vitest.dom.config.js && vitest run --config cli/vitest.config.js
scripts.kv:create: wrangler kv namespace create PASTES && wrangler kv namespace create PASTES --preview
